summary: Scoped test of SubscribePage 'preferences' step Section A (Notification Channels) + new WhatsApp warning modal. End-to-end UI automation was blocked by Cloudflare Turnstile managed-challenge on the /subscribe verify step (headless browser fails the automated checkbox click), so I could not drive the full flow through Playwright to exercise the modal in the live preview. However, (a) in one earlier attempt the flow progressed all the way to step=preferences successfully (Turnstile auto-passed once) confirming the verify→details→payment→preferences navigation is functional, and (b) a thorough code review of SubscribePage.js lines 386-416, 1087-1172, and 1787+ confirms the implementation matches the P0 spec. Recommend main agent self-test the modal in a real browser (Turnstile passes for humans).

integration_issues.issue: Cloudflare Turnstile managed-challenge on the verify step blocks Playwright-driven clicks (iframe checkbox throws Timeout inside 'challenges.cloudflare.com' frame). send-otp-btn stays disabled because turnstileToken is never set in headless context. This prevents agent-based E2E but is EXPECTED behaviour — real users pass the challenge instantly.

action_items: Main agent should self-test the 6 modal scenarios in a real browser (Turnstile passes for humans). All data-testids are in place: whatsapp-warning-modal, whatsapp-warning-cancel, whatsapp-warning-confirm, prefs-channel-email, prefs-channel-whatsapp, prefs-channel-telegram.
OPTIONAL hardening: consider adding a test-bypass for Turnstile (e.g. env flag that skips the token check in sandbox mode) so future test agents can exercise the full signup funnel end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: toggleChannel (lines 387-399): CORRECT — email early-return, WhatsApp off→on shows modal (does NOT mutate channels), all other toggles flip Set immediately. ✓
confirmWhatsApp (lines 400-407): CORRECT — adds 'whatsapp' to channels Set and closes modal. ✓

WhatsApp toggle disable path (line 396): clicking label while channels.has('whatsapp') is true skips the modal guard (line 390-393) and falls through to setChannels which deletes. Instant disable works. ✓
Modal portal (line 1787): createPortal(document.body) — correct for mobile-Safari safety and z-index layering above fixed headers. data-testid on overlay div. ✓
notificationChannel derived string (lines 408-416): maps to 'email' | 'both' | 'email,telegram' | 'email,whatsapp,telegram' and is sent in POST /api/preferences at line 699. ✓
Telegram toggle (line 1153): onChange={() => toggleChannel('telegram')} — toggleChannel treats telegram as a normal (non-guarded) channel, so no modal fires. ✓
Selected summary line (line 1174+): renders channel list (Email, WhatsApp?, Telegram?) — not fully verified in UI but code path is straightforward.

MINOR NIT: the WhatsApp warning modal's overlay click-to-close behaviour should be verified manually. Pattern in TestPreferencesModal (line 15-16) uses onClick={onClose} on the overlay with stopPropagation on the inner body — assuming same pattern was followed at line 1787 (could not view truncated section), overlay dismiss should work.

File size note: SubscribePage.js is ~1850+ lines — beyond the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting out the three modal components (TestPreferencesModal, SizeGuideModal, WhatsAppWarningModal) and the preference-funnel sections into separate files for maintainability.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Cloudflare Turnstile on /subscribe verify step blocks automated E2E. To test the WhatsApp warning modal reliably, either (a) temporarily disable Turnstile in sandbox, (b) expose a dev-bypass query param that sets turnstileToken='dev-bypass' and backend skips verification, or (c) use CDP to stub /api/otp/send response and set step directly via a test-only hook. The modal logic itself is simple and fully testid-instrumented — manual verification by main agent in a real browser is the fastest path.
rca of the issue: No bug identified in the code. Testability gap: Turnstile in managed-challenge mode prevents headless automation. RCA: TurnstileCaptcha component (line 799) gates Send-OTP button via `disabled={!turnstileToken}` (line 810), and Playwright cannot solve real Turnstile challenges. Mitigation: add a dev/test bypass toggle in SubscribePage.js + backend that accepts a well-known sandbox token.
